metadata.name: clamp
metadata.description: Clamp: two-way GPU rental price lock (index, series, pool, vault, locks)

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buys claims of one side through the pool.

accounts.name: user_collateral
docs: The user's collateral account (its mint is checked by every transfer).

accounts.name: user_claims
docs: The user's token account of the traded side (UP or DOWN mint).

instructions.name: create_series
docs: Creates the next series of a class and kind. Anyone, after the previous one expired.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposits collateral for vault shares. Remaining accounts: active series and their IndexStates.

instructions.name: init_index
docs: Creates the index of a class and binds its observation ring. Admin only.

accounts.name: observations
docs: Fresh account of `Observations::SIZE` bytes owned by this program and
still all zero (`zero` checks both and writes the discriminator).

instructions.name: init_vault
docs: Creates the vault, its share mint and idle account. Admin, once.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the global config. Upgrade authority only, once.

instructions.name: merge_pairs
docs: Returns `amount` UP and `amount` DOWN, receives `amount` collateral.

instructions.name: mint_pairs
docs: Pays `amount` collateral, receives `amount` UP and `amount` DOWN.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burns settled claims of one side for their value in collateral.

accounts.name: claim_mint
docs: The UP or DOWN mint of the series, matching `side`.

instructions.name: seed_series
docs: Puts the vault's allocation into the pool of a series. Anyone, once.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sells claims of one side through the pool.

accounts.name: user_collateral
docs: The user's collateral account (its mint is checked by every transfer).

accounts.name: user_claims
docs: The user's token account of the traded side (UP or DOWN mint).

instructions.name: set_class
docs: Creates or updates a GPU class. Admin only.

instructions.name: settle_series
docs: Settles an expired series from the index period average. Anyone.

instructions.name: submit_report
docs: Stores a reporter's report and updates the index when allowed.

instructions.name: sweep_series
docs: Returns the vault's units of a settled series to idle USDC. Anyone.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Burns vault shares for idle collateral. Remaining accounts as for `deposit`.

types.name: ClassConfig
docs: Settings of one GPU class. PDA `["class", class_id]`.
Reporters, quorum, bounds and widths affect future updates and future
series only. The sources are fixed when the class is created, because the
stored reports are read by source slot.

fields.name: class_id
docs: 1 = RTX 4090, 2 = H100. 0 means the account was just created.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Sanity bounds for one reported price, micro-USD per GPU-hour.

fields.name: half_width_ppm
docs: Band half width per series kind: daily, weekly, monthly.

fields.name: current_series
docs: The latest series per kind (set by create_series).

fields.name: current_expiry
docs: Expiry of the latest series per kind; 0 = none yet. Taken from the
reserved bytes in M2 (D-056), so existing accounts read 0.

fields.name: series_count
docs: Series created so far per kind; the next series uses this number in its
PDA seeds (D-056).

fields.name: sources
docs: Must equal the stored sources when the class already exists.

types.name: Config
docs: Global settings. PDA `["config"]`.
The layout is final: it must not change once the account exists on devnet
(architecture 3.1). New fields go into `_reserved`.

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: Collateral of every series (tUSDC on devnet).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Token account of `collateral_mint` that receives protocol fees.

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: Copied into each new series.

fields.name: protocol_share_bps
docs: Share of each trade fee that goes to the treasury.

fields.name: series_alloc_bps
docs: Vault NAV allocated to one series when it is seeded.

types.name: IndexState
docs: Live index of one class. PDA `["index", class_id]`.
`last_*` and `cum_*` equal the newest observation once `update_count > 0`.

fields.name: observations
docs: The `Observations` account bound by `init_index`.

fields.name: obs_index
docs: Ring slot of the newest observation.

fields.name: obs_count
docs: Filled ring slots.

fields.name: reports
docs: Indexed by reporter slot of the class.

types.name: IndexUpdated
docs: An index update was accepted and recorded (spec 6.2 step 7, 6.3).

fields.name: price
docs: Recorded price after the step limit.

fields.name: candidate
docs: Weighted median before the step limit.

fields.name: reporter_count
docs: Fresh reports that formed this update.

types.name: ObservationSlot
docs: One stored index update. `cum_price` is split into two `u64` halves so the
struct has 8-byte alignment and no padding (zero-copy safe). 40 bytes.

types.name: Observations
docs: Ring of index updates of one class (spec 6.3).
Not a PDA: about 80 KB is more than a program can allocate in one
instruction, so the setup script creates it with a fresh keypair at full
size, owned by this program, and `init_index` binds it to the class.

types.name: Report
docs: The latest report of one reporter slot.

fields.name: reporter
docs: Who sent it. A report counts only while this key is still in the slot.

fields.name: used
docs: Already part of an accepted update.

fields.name: prices
docs: By source slot. 0 = the source did not answer.

types.name: ReportSubmitted
docs: A reporter's report was stored (spec 6.2). Carries the raw response hashes.

fields.name: prices
docs: By source slot of the class. 0 = the source did not answer.

fields.name: raw_hashes
docs: SHA-256 of the archived raw API response, by source slot.

types.name: Series
docs: One series of a class and kind (spec 7). PDA
`["series", class_id, kind, seq (u32 LE)]`, `seq` = the class's
`series_count[kind]` at creation (D-056).
The layout is final from M2 on (architecture 3.1): the pool and vault
fields are here from the start, so a live weekly series survives the M2
pool work. New fields go into `_reserved`.

fields.name: center
docs: Band, micro-USD per GPU-hour.

fields.name: start_index
docs: Index price at creation (used when the period has no counted time).

fields.name: start_cum_price
docs: Running sums of the class index at `start_ts`.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Collateral token account of the series (owner: the series PDA).

fields.name: up_vault
docs: Vault-owned UP and DOWN units (pool plus inventory), owner: the series PDA.

fields.name: pairs_outstanding
docs: Pairs minted and not merged yet, including the vault's.

fields.name: avg
docs: Period average, micro-USD per GPU-hour.

fields.name: up_value
docs: Value of one UP claim in micro-USDC (ppm of 1 USDC).

fields.name: coverage_ppm
docs: Counted time of the period in ppm of its duration.

types.name: SeriesCreated
docs: A series was created (spec 7.1).

types.name: SeriesSettled
docs: A series was settled (spec 11).

types.name: Source
docs: One price source of a class, in the order of the report slots.

fields.name: source_id
docs: 1 Vast.ai, 2 RunPod, 3 Akash, 4 Nosana.

fields.name: has_capacity
docs: True: weight by capacity tier. False: use `fixed_weight`.

types.name: SourceUsed
docs: One source as it entered an index update.

fields.name: price
docs: Combined price across reporters. 0 = the source was left out.

fields.name: weight
docs: Weight in the weighted median. 0 = left out.

types.name: Trade
docs: A pool trade (spec 8.3, 8.4). `usdc` is paid in (buy) or paid out (sell).

types.name: Vault
docs: The liquidity vault (spec 9). PDA `["vault"]`. Owns the share mint
`["shares"]` and the idle collateral account `["idle"]`.

fields.name: active_series
docs: Seeded and not yet swept series, in seeding order.

fields.name: locked_shares
docs: Share units of the first deposit that nobody owns (spec 9.2). They
count in the total supply for every share price.
